scope: Independent final read-only review of immutable whole-analysis publication, retained committed generations, owner/curated HTTP selection and cache policy, pinned media/report readers, and native-worker publication integration.
reviewConclusions: Explicit generation resolution requires current-pointer proof or a committed-history receipt. Sealed candidates rejected by final verification/CAS remain diagnostic and cannot be opened as completed history.

Publication binds database and copied media/timing/metadata/export files in one content-addressed manifest. Shared publication locking and pointer CAS preserve the previous complete generation on rejected publication; legacy database-only publication cannot replace a full generation.

ResultDocument and full-generation asset routes pin one selected generation, enforce analysis identity and exact integer revision alignment, and fail without mutable-root fallback. HTML validates declared annotation bytes before response headers and ignores undeclared annotation files.

Owners retain latest and historical access. A full-generation public catalog entry must explicitly select its generation; guest and other-account bare URLs resolve that approved generation, private later generations remain inaccessible, and removing curation revokes public access.

AccessMiddleware now forces every authenticated response to private, no-store. Curated account-mode responses add Vary: Cookie, including owner latest-private responses reached through curated bare URLs.

Native-worker publication is reached after checkpoint/input revalidation and source/browser frame-count checks, with a final cancellation/identity callback immediately before pointer commit. Job completion follows publication.

closedFindings.originalObservationLimit: Observed response-body selection and header policy; no shared-cache data leak was demonstrated.

closedFindings.coverage: Nine bare result/media/export paths select private latest for owner and approved old generation for guest; authenticated responses stay private; Cookie variation is present; Range 206 and an authenticated visitor to the approved pinned generation are covered.

integrationV3.mediaScope: Existing demo regression uses three synthetic 100x100 OpenCV frames; generation HTTP fixtures use synthetic undecoded bytes; no actual match video.

earlierIndependentSubagentRun.scope: First three fixes plus the then-current 11 HTTP cases; this run predates the final cache fix and cache regression. The current cache fix is supported by code review and the recorded integration_v3 run, not by a new subagent rerun.

limitations: This is publication/storage and HTTP integration review, not full master-prompt acceptance.
HTTP fixtures use synthetic media bytes; HTML image extraction is mocked at the selected asset-directory boundary. Existing integrated demo coverage decodes only three synthetic OpenCV frames.
No new suite, actual inference, model training, independent tennis accuracy, long-match playback, live video, or network deployment qualification was performed for this final review.
Corrected point/timeline regeneration and corrected full-analysis publication are not implemented or claimed by this immutable-generation foundation.
